steps.name: audit-release-and-debug-package-identity-references
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git fetch --no-tags origin fix/release-wireless-adb-20261123
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
TMP="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-gsm-grep-XXXXXX)"
trap 'cd "$ROOT"; git worktree remove --force "$TMP" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
git worktree add --detach "$TMP" origin/fix/release-wireless-adb-20261123 >/dev/null
cd "$TMP"
echo "QA_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
grep -RnE 'GsmShellMediaProtocol\.S8_PACKAGE|LocalAdbGsmPolicy\.(START|STATUS)|\.gsmbinder|S8_PACKAGE|CallMediaBackendMode' app/src/main scripts 2>/dev/null | head -180 || true
echo GSM_GREP_PASS=true
